common.networkHint: Check the network connection and try again.

home.title: {name}, keep moving forward
home.description: Start from the real to-do items and recent records, and finish today's study at your own pace.
home.statPendingGrading: Awaiting grading, not scored as zero
home.recentDescription: Continue an unfinished session, or open a report that has already been submitted
home.emptyDescription: Your external Agent can create study content and practice sets; real records show up here once they are done.
home.toolsDescription: Review what you missed, look back at your history, or authorize an Agent to prepare what comes next.

topics.title: Learning topics
topics.description: Each topic organizes plans, reading content, practice and exams around one clear goal.
topics.emptyDescription: There are no topics in progress. Tell your external Agent about the learning goal so it can create topics, plans and content through the authorized API; no sample courses are shown here.

topicDetail.archivedDescription: You can read the existing records, but cannot start new tasks.
topicDetail.emptyPlansDescription: Let the Agent create phases and tasks from the topic goal; plans are really stored on the server.
topicDetail.emptyContentsDescription: The Agent can write plain-text learning content around the current goal.
topicDetail.emptyAssessmentsDescription: Let the Agent create questions with explicit grading rules and assemble them into a paper; an empty library never shows fake scores.

plan.notFoundDescription: The plan may be archived or no longer available. Go back to the topic to see the current plans.
plan.description: {count} phases to work through in order; reading content counts as done when it opens, and other tasks are completed manually.
plan.archivedNotice: This plan is archived. Its history is still readable.
plan.emptyPhase: This phase has no tasks yet
plan.notifyLoadFailed: Could not load the learning plan

content.completionError: The reading content is open, but the task could not be marked complete automatically: {error}
content.notifyCompletionError: Failed to complete the reading task automatically

assessment.examDescription: Confirm the time and network before you start; the exam follows the server deadline and the submitted state.
assessment.practiceDescription: Practice lets you submit one question at a time and read the grading feedback; model questions may take a while.
assessment.archivedDescription: No new session can be started; existing attempts and reports are unaffected.
assessment.badgePractice: Submitted per question / instant rule feedback
assessment.rulesExam: Exam questions are not graded before the exam starts, and no standard answers or score items are shown. After the whole paper is submitted, only the answered content enters the grading flow.
assessment.rulesPractice: A question is locked once submitted and its answer cannot be changed. Rule questions are graded immediately; model questions and externally graded questions clearly show a waiting state.
assessment.sideItem1: An answer only counts in the server session after it is saved successfully.
assessment.sideItem2: Losing the network, switching apps or changing the device clock does not extend the server deadline.
assessment.sideItem3: Answers to model-graded questions may be sent to the grading model configured by the administrator.
assessment.sideItem4: Pending grading and failed grading are both not zero points.

attempt.publicTestNotice: Test attempt: you can answer, submit and be graded as usual, but it does not count towards learning statistics, wrong questions or plan progress.
attempt.errorTitle: Could not open the answering session
attempt.errorDescription: Check the network connection and try again; the reason is shown in the notification.
attempt.backToPlanLabel: Save and return to the learning plan
attempt.backToTopicLabel: Save and return to the topic
attempt.kindPractice: Practice · short answers are graded after submission
attempt.answerSavedToServer: Answers are saved only on the current server
attempt.publicNoticeTest: Answers from the link holder are recorded under the link owner's account; test attempts do not count towards learning statistics, wrong questions or plan progress. Do not forward this link.
attempt.publicNoticeFormal: Answers from the link holder are recorded under the link owner's account and count towards that user's learning statistics, wrong questions and plan progress. Do not forward this link.
attempt.expiredDescription: Refreshing the submitted state; the device clock does not change the deadline.
attempt.trueFalse: Decide whether it is true or false
attempt.submitDialogDescription: After submitting, the answers are frozen and enter grading, and they can no longer be changed.
attempt.submitNoteTest: A test attempt does not complete the plan task.
attempt.submitNoteExam: Submitting an official exam satisfies the answering task even if every answer is left blank.
attempt.submitNotePractice: Leaving every answer blank in an official practice does not complete the plan task.
attempt.submitHint: A successful submission means the answers are handed in; model questions may then show as pending grading, which never means zero points.
attempt.leaveDialogTitle: Some answers are not saved yet
attempt.leaveDialogDescription: If you leave now, this content is not treated as saved on the server. Leave anyway?
attempt.leaveDialogHint: Stay on this page and retry the save to avoid losing this change.
attempt.notifySessionError: Failed to load the answering session
attempt.saveConflict: The answer version conflicts, please reload the session and do not overwrite changes from another device
attempt.notifyCannotSubmitBody: Some answers are not saved yet, please resolve the save errors first.
attempt.notifySubmittedBody: The answers are frozen and have entered the grading flow.
attempt.missingSaveItem: The server save response is missing the current question

report.testNotice: You can answer, submit and be graded as usual, but it does not count towards learning statistics, wrong questions or plan progress.
report.formalNotice: An official attempt that is not voided counts towards the owner's learning statistics, wrong questions and plan progress.
report.voidedDescription: It no longer counts towards learning statistics, wrong questions or plan progress; it cannot be edited, submitted or graded again, and the history is kept.
report.answerLinkNotice: An answer-link attempt is recorded under the link owner's account; after signing in you can only view it read-only and cannot change the link's answers.
report.regradingDescription: The current valid score is still shown, and a new result never silently clears the old score.
report.notFinalTitle: The report is not final yet
report.notFinalDescription: Graded points and points pending grading are shown separately; pending grading is not zero points.
report.failedCountTitle: Grading did not finish for {count} questions
report.failedCountDescription: A failure is not zero points. Refresh later, or wait for an administrator to restore the grading task.
report.taskNoteTest: This record does not count towards plan progress.
report.taskNoteExam: Submitting an official exam satisfies the answering task even if every answer is left blank.
report.taskNotePractice: Leaving every answer blank in an official practice does not complete the plan task.
report.emptyDescription: This report has no questions to show.
report.voidDialogDescription: This cannot be undone: the attempt is read-only and no longer counts towards learning statistics, wrong questions or plan progress, and it cannot be answered, submitted or graded again. Existing records and grading history are kept.
report.voidReasonLabel: Reason for voiding (required, at most 4000 characters)
report.voidReasonHint: Please confirm the current record and the reason; on a version conflict you have to view it again before confirming.
report.notifyVoidedBody: The record and existing grades are kept, but it no longer counts towards learning statistics and it cannot be answered, submitted or graded again.

wrongQuestions.title: Wrong questions
wrongQuestions.description: Only graded questions that did not reach full marks are collected here; partial scores are worth reviewing too, and pending grading never enters this list.
wrongQuestions.wrongCount: Wrong {count} times in total · most recently at {date}
wrongQuestions.emptyDescription: After real grading, questions that did not reach full marks enter here by the server rules. No records means no invented accuracy is shown.

wrongQuestionDetail.loadFailed: Failed to load the wrong question details
wrongQuestionDetail.title: Wrong question details
wrongQuestionDetail.description: Wrong {count} times in total · last wrong at {date}
wrongQuestionDetail.masteryDescription: Only the review status is recorded, and no historical score is changed
wrongQuestionDetail.historyDescription: Every attempt is kept separately, and practising again never overwrites older records
wrongQuestionDetail.noHistoryNotice: The server did not return the wrong-answer history; look for the matching attempt under "Learning history".
wrongQuestionDetail.notifyLoadError: Failed to load the wrong question details
wrongQuestionDetail.notifyMasteryUpdated: The mastery status has been updated
wrongQuestionDetail.notifyMasteryError: Failed to update the mastery status

history.title: Learning history
history.description: Official attempts count towards learning statistics; test attempts and voided attempts do not. An answer-link attempt is recorded under the owner's account and is read-only once you sign in.
history.timeExpired: Closed automatically when the time expired
history.emptyTitle: No learning records match the filters
history.emptyDescription: Adjust the filters, or start a real practice from a topic. No sample scores are generated here.

assistant.pageHint: Use the assistant panel on the side. It can read your learning data, create content, and open pages for you.
assistant.modelMissing: The administrator has not configured a default assistant model yet.
